objectives: Introduction to scientific programming with Python.
content: Designed for absolute beginners with no prior programming experience, this course utilizes a flipped-classroom model. Students are expected to review online videos and reading materials prior to attending. During class, students will bring their own laptops to complete hands-on exercises that extensively incorporate AI coding agents.
books:
Introduction to Scientific Programming with Python, by Joakim Sundnes, Springer, 2020 (https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-50356-7)
Scipy Lecture Note (https://scipy-lectures.org/)
teaching_method:
講授

實習/實驗
個別指導
